characters.name: Suitor (Gut)
characters.prompt: A somewhat modest young man dressed in simple, slightly worn 1400s–1850s Norwegian rural attire with a hopeful expression, carrying a small bundle or gift to present to the family.

characters.name: Father (Mann)
characters.prompt: A poor Norwegian farmer from the 1400s–1850s wearing an old jacket with a mismatched new sleeve; he attempts to dust and clean surfaces with this fresh sleeve while keeping the other arm behind his back to conceal the worn side.

characters.name: Mother (Kone)
characters.prompt: A woman in old Norwegian peasant clothing, visibly worn but with one new shoe that she uses to nudge and kick objects aside, trying to appear tidy and well-off.

characters.name: Daughter (Datter)
characters.prompt: A young lady wearing a simple dress from rural 1400s–1850s Norway, with a newly acquired bonnet (lue). She peeks through a doorway, tilting her head about to create an impression of being busy.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustration set in a modest Norwegian farmhouse from the 1400s–1850s. The father in a worn jacket with one new sleeve dusts the wooden table, the mother in a threadbare dress with one new shoe tidies while kicking objects, and the daughter peeks in with a new bonnet. The suitor stands in the center, looking surprised by their attempts to appear wealthy. Wooden beams, a simple hearth, and rustic furniture emphasize the rural setting and olden-day atmosphere.
modernMainImagePrompt: A present-day Norwegian household scene, slightly cluttered but made to look ‘wealthy’ with mismatched items: a father in a modern jacket with a freshly stitched sleeve tidies the living room with it, a mother wearing a casual outfit but sporting one brand-new sneaker moves objects around, and a daughter in comfy loungewear with a brand-new stylish cap peeks in. The modern suitor appears uncertain, phone in hand. The background might include a contemporary Scandinavian interior, such as minimal furnishings and large windows overlooking a Norwegian neighborhood.
childMainImagePrompt: A bright, cheerful illustration of a small, cozy wooden house in old Norway. The father, wearing a funny jacket with a fresh sleeve, dusts a chair, the mother in a colorful dress and one shiny new shoe hops around tidying, and the smiling daughter peeks with a vibrant new bonnet. The friendly suitor watches wide-eyed. Show warm lighting, simple wooden walls, and playful details that make the scene silly and inviting for a 5-year-old.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Et bilde av en liten norsk stue fra gamle dager. Faren har en slitt jakke med kun ett nytt erme, moren har på seg slitte klær og én ny sko, og datteren har en ny lue på hodet. Alle prøver å se velstående ut. Beholderen av historien er frieren som kommer inn i rommet og merker at familien gjør sitt beste for å imponere, mens treverket i huset og en knitrende peis gir en klassisk, koselig stemning.
englishMainImagePrompt: An illustration set in a small Norwegian cottage from the olden days. The father, wearing a worn jacket with one new sleeve, dusts furnishings with it; the mother, in threadbare clothes but with a single new shoe, tidies around; and the daughter stands behind a doorframe, proudly nodding with her newly acquired bonnet. The suitor appears at the center, both amused and puzzled, as they try to look prosperous despite their humble surroundings.
